source: Harbourline Toyota promotions register (static stand-in). Served only when Progress Agentic RAG is not configured or unreachable and no composed set (promotions.generated.json) exists. Fictional offers for the prototype.
notes: appliesTo: every non-null constraint must match. models/units/bodies null = any. aged:true = only units in the Domo aged-stock actions list. onLot:true (extension) = only units physically on a lot (not in transit).

promotions.title: Complimentary 3-year Toyota Service Advantage
promotions.desc: Your first three years of capped-price logbook servicing are on us.
promotions.why: Toyota Service Advantage servicing included for the first three years on this car
promotions.reason: Clears aged RAV4 and Kluger units before the December model-year changeover without cutting the advertised price.

promotions.title: Genuine accessories bundle worth $1,500
promotions.desc: Choose $1,500 of Toyota Genuine accessories, such as a tow bar, roof racks or cargo liner, fitted before delivery.
promotions.why: Pick the Genuine accessories you want, fitted before delivery
promotions.reason: Kluger hybrid allocation is strong this quarter; a bundle moves volume while protecting the drive-away price.

promotions.title: Trade-in bonus $1,000
promotions.desc: We add $1,000 to the valuation of your trade-in on this car.
promotions.why: A little extra for the car you trade in
promotions.reason: Units over 60 days carry floorplan interest; a trade-in bonus moves them faster than a price cut.

promotions.title: Towing Pack fitted free
promotions.desc: A genuine tow bar, tongue and wiring harness, fitted and rated to the vehicle's braked towing capacity, at no charge.
promotions.why: Ready to tow from day one with a Genuine Towing Pack
promotions.reason: Co-op accessory funding for towing-focused models runs to the end of the year, and towing buyers decide faster with the pack fitted.

promotions.title: Delivery to your door
promotions.desc: We deliver your new Toyota to your home or work anywhere within 50 km of our sites and walk you through it there.
promotions.why: We bring your new Toyota to you
promotions.reason: On-lot units free up yard space, and our delivery runs within 50 km are already scheduled.

promotions.title: Reduced-rate Toyota Finance on small hybrids
promotions.desc: Ask about a reduced comparison rate with Toyota Finance on approved credit; fees, charges and conditions apply.
promotions.why: Finance options to suit a small hybrid SUV
promotions.reason: Manufacturer-supported rate on small-SUV hybrids this quarter (fictional demo terms).

promotions.title: $750 towards a home wallbox installation
promotions.desc: We contribute $750 to having a 7 kW wallbox installed at your home by our accredited electrician.
promotions.why: Help getting home charging set up
promotions.reason: Home charging is the most common objection from EV buyers, and the Hornsby bZ4X is past 50 days in stock.

promotions.title: Tub liner and tie-down kit fitted free
promotions.short: a free tub liner and tie-down kit
promotions.desc: A heavy-duty tub liner and tie-down kit fitted to this HiLux before you take it home.
promotions.why: A tub liner and tie-downs fitted before you collect
promotions.reason: HL-2399 is 88 days in stock; the manager approved an accessory add-in rather than a price cut.
